The '''Heartache Bistro''' was a [[Cantina/Legends|cantina]] located in [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa's]] [[Red Light Sector (Nar Shaddaa)|Red Light Sector]]. Though initially a poor, rarely visited location, a new owner named [[Narissa]] helped to transform the Bistro into one of Nar Shaddaa's premier [[Restaurant/Legends|restaurants]]. During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], the Bistro entered into an agreement with a [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Kajidic/Legends|kajidic]] to sell [[Tempest (spice)|Tempest spice]].<ref name="LoNH" />
